decision.explanation: The query asks for the conflict associated with 'Battle of Beirut'. The source documents identify three distinct historical events with this name, each associated with a different conflict: 1) The 1912 Battle of Beirut occurred during the 'Italo-Turkish War' (D1S1). 2) The 1941 Battle of Beirut marked the end of hostilities in the 'Syria-Lebanon campaign' of 'World War II' (D2S1); while 'Syria-Lebanon campaign' is the specific campaign, 'World War II' is the broader conflict explicitly named in the text. 3) The 'Siege of Beirut' (often conflated or listed under similar headings in historical contexts) took place as part of the '1982 Lebanon War' (D5S5). The candidate 'Syria-Lebanon campaign' (C3) is a specific campaign within World War II, but 'World War II' is the direct conflict answer provided in the source text for the 1941 event. All three answers represent distinct valid referents for the ambiguous entity name 'Battle of Beirut'.
